why: invoice.py must get tax from tax.py without tax rules in invoice.py. Pricing supplies customer region, discount, and line amounts; tax.py only computes tax.

value: region=None (unknown customer, no region) -> tax 0, no error. A region string not in rates.csv -> KeyError. pricing.py is expected to raise KeyError for unknown customers before tax is reached.
why: RULES.md says an unknown customer pays 0%, but the team standard says a lookup that finds nothing raises KeyError. Reconciled: the 0% case is signalled explicitly by region=None; any other miss raises KeyError.

value: Money in integer cents everywhere. Percents are percent numbers (8.875 means 8.875%). Tax uses exact decimal arithmetic (decimal.Decimal, no float). Discount is applied to the taxable sum, then the rate; only the final tax is rounded to whole cents with ROUND_HALF_UP.
why: Matches team standard (cents, percent numbers) and RULES.md (round only the final tax, half up). Avoids float error for values like 8.875%.
